notes: Source: every note came from the live collection on Sep 29 (3,206 unique notes), before the later Morsanki reconciliation pass added AnKing cards to built lectures. Cards were counted from each note's actual card list. The Morsanki numbers match the counts published in its add-on within ±5 cards on all 28 rows
L04 is left out: nobody built it for Manhattanki, and everyone used Morsanki for it

Labs: on lab days the Morsanki add-on puts the lab rows (Gluteal, Anterior Thigh, Posterior Leg) under the postlab ELs, so they are compared against L15, L23 and L27. The Gluteal lab row also re-opens all 190 L04 prelab notes through its Anatomy:: tag; those are taken out, so L15 is 71 notes / 145 cards (the add-on shows 382)

Double counting: the L23 and L27 lab rows re-open the whole prelab tag. Adding up the add-on rows gives 3,492 Morsanki cards, but only 2,807 are different cards. Manhattanki rows add up to 1,622, and 1,444 are different cards (105 notes sit under more than one lecture)
Manhattanki add-on counts were stale on a few rows on Sep 29: L16 121 (published 92), L19 116 (102), L20 93 (69), L10 67 (59), L07 57 (64)

Left out: optional rows (Vaccine Spam, 54 IO cards, and the Morsanki "C1T3L01 (AnKing)" row). Nathanki appears in both add-ons; the collection has no nathanglutepl or shivanshuantlab cards, so those couldn't be measured

takeaways: Manhattanki was 51% of Morsanki's size (1,444 vs 2,807 cards), and had more cards on only 4 of 28 lectures: L01, L11, L17, L20
Regular lectures: Manhattanki was 66% of Morsanki's size. Anatomy labs: 29%, mostly Morsanki's lab image-occlusion sets (386 IO notes vs 57)
63% of Manhattanki's AnKing picks are also in Morsanki. Biggest AnKing cuts: L10 (13 vs 65), L02 (28 vs 53), L24 (21 vs 45), L26 (10 vs 28)
Manhattanki tagged more AnKing than Morsanki on 8 lectures: L01, L05, L11, L12, L16, L17, L19, L20

notes: Source: every note came from the live collection on Oct 14 (880 unique notes). Cards were counted from each note's actual card list. Morsanki's published counts match exactly on all 6 rows (122 / 95 / 160 / 89 / 116 / 211). Manhattanki's published counts match on L02 to L05 (59 / 32 / 155 / 66); L06 and L07 have no published count yet
Only L02 to L07 are compared: they are the lectures built so far. L01 (the course intro) is never built, and L08 onward have not been built yet. The optional Blood Virtual Microscopy row is left out

L04: the Morsanki prelab row opens both its Thorax lab tag and its thorax anatomy tag (134 notes). The postlab (L10) has its own row and is not counted yet. Manhattanki L04 includes 33 BlueLink atlas image-occlusion notes
Double counting: Morsanki rows add up to 793 cards, but only 788 are different cards (5 notes sit under two rows). Manhattanki rows add up to 526, with 523 different (2 notes sit under two lectures)

Manhattanki only tags an AnKing card when the lecture mentions its fact. The Oct 13 mention check removed unmentioned AnKing cards from L02, L03 and L05, which is most of the L02 and L03 AnKing gap. 12 Morsanki AnKing cards sit under a different lecture in Manhattanki
The 132 Morsanki AnKing notes not in Manhattanki, by AnKing yield: 36 high, 46 relatively high, 27 high (temporary), 10 lower, 4 low, 9 with no yield tag
Cloze text length is counted with the cloze brackets and formatting removed
takeaways: Manhattanki is 66% of Morsanki's size so far (523 vs 788 cards over 6 lectures), and has fewer cards on all 6
Regular lectures: Manhattanki is 59% of Morsanki's size (368 vs 628). Anatomy prelab: 97% (155 vs 160), with 71 image-occlusion notes vs 81
54% of Morsanki's AnKing picks are also in Manhattanki, and 71% of Manhattanki's are in Morsanki. Biggest AnKing cuts: L02 (35 vs 78), L07 (56 vs 86) and L03 (18 vs 47)
Manhattanki tagged more AnKing than Morsanki on L04 (19 vs 1) and L05 (38 vs 24)
